description: One TikTok Commercial Content Library ad by ID — calendar-day dates, always 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Default GB.

url.description: TikTok Ad Library URL or ad ID. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_ad_library_ad_details
title: TikTok Ad Details
